description: Delete a text frame, image frame, rectangle, line or group (as a whole) by frame_id. A threaded text frame (verketteter Rahmen) takes its own text portion with it; the rest of the story stays in the other frames. There is no undo. Returns frame_id, type, was_threaded, characters_removed and removed_frame_ids (group members included). characters_removed counts only the text portion taken out of a threaded chain; it is 0 for an unthreaded frame, whose story is deleted together with the frame. A frame holding a managed story (editorial workflow, also when locked) is deleted anyway, with a warning; the story file on disk stays.

document_id.description: Document to act on, from list_documents or open_document. Without it the frontmost document is used. A document opened with show_window false is never the active one and must always be addressed by id.

name: delete_frame
title: Delete an object
